collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A teenager acting as judge in a children's game sees their own younger sibling step outside the line.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a teenager, acting as judge in a children's game sees their own younger sibling step outside the line.

choices.label: Ask Another Player Whether They Saw It.
Step Aside as Judge for This Game.
Explain the Rule to Everyone Again.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The other children respect the judge more, and the sibling sulks only briefly.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The sibling is upset for the rest of the afternoon, and the judge comforts them afterward without taking back the call.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Another child confirms the step, and the call is made without anyone feeling singled out.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Nobody else saw it clearly, so the point is played again.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Another teenager takes over, and the game carries on fairly.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: No one else wants to judge, and the children decide to finish without one.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The sibling realizes the mistake on their own and accepts the point.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The rule turns out to be unclear, and the children agree on a better line.
